name: The Devil's Bargain
text: A smiling stranger lays two relics on the road and names his price: a wound.

options.text: Take a wound and take this relic.

name: The Moneylender
text: She deals in gold and in blood, and she buys as readily as she sells.

options.text: Take a wound and gain 100 gold.
Pay 70 gold and heal your wounds.

name: The Wandering Smith
text: The smith will melt down one of your cards and forge something finer from it. She won't say what.

options.text: Give up a card of your choice for a random card one rarity higher.

name: All or Nothing
text: A pedlar's bundle, tied shut with wire. He sells it whole or not at all, and today it is free.

name: The Rival's Wager
text: A rival duelist tosses you a purse. "Keep it. You'll fight your next duel hurt, and I'll enjoy watching."

options.text: Gain 50 gold. You start your next duel with 5 less life.

modifier.name: Rival's Wager
modifier.text: You start your next duel with 5 less life.
